TRANSCRIBE BURST K1-tr-L — part inventory of Keeper identity master L against the F04 bible (O9; charter § 6 v1.1). task_id "K1-tr-L".

You are a separate instance: you have not seen any generator prompt, receipt or prior inventory, and you must not look for one.

Inputs (read-only):
- Image 1 (attached): the figure to inventory, a native-resolution crop of a painted concept sheet.
- Question set: /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-1/k1/questions.json — a JSON list of atomic questions over a CLOSED part list (presence question, then a dependent count question, per part).
- Strict answer schema: /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-1/k1/inventory.schema.json — out/inventory.json must conform to it EXACTLY (every listed part; keys `present` boolean and `count` integer ≥ 0; no other keys, no coordinates, no free text).

Part glossary (use these definitions, nothing else): hair = the hair mass on the head · face = the visible face · shirt = the under-garment with sleeves [bible: ivory linen] · tabard = the sleeveless over-garment [bible: navy wool] · belt = a WAIST belt (one belt with several buckles is 1) [bible: chestnut leather] · satchel = a bag hung from a strap or belt [bible: olive waxed canvas with brass corners] · harness_strap = a strap crossing the torso (NOT a waist belt; an X of two = 2) [bible: chestnut leather] · pauldron_L = a shoulder plate on the figure's LEFT shoulder (figure faces you: its left is YOUR right) [bible: white-lacquered plate] · pauldron_R = a shoulder plate on the figure's RIGHT shoulder [bible: white-lacquered plate] · bracer_L = a forearm guard on the figure's LEFT forearm [bible: chestnut leather] · bracer_R = a forearm guard on the figure's RIGHT forearm [bible: chestnut leather] · trousers = the leg garment [bible: navy wool] · boots = footwear (a pair = 2) [bible: chestnut leather] · rod = a hand-held instrument on a shaft (staff, rod, or short-handled device) [bible: dark walnut shaft] · rod_head = the distinct head-piece of that instrument [bible: brass ring head] · helmet = head armour · cape = a cloak or cape · shield = a shield · quiver = a container for arrows on the back or hip

Rules: answer ONLY the parts listed in the schema — the schema forbids any other key; answer every question by looking at Image 1 only. Count distinct visible instances (a pair of boots = 2; one belt with two buckles = 1). Parts that are in the list but not on this figure MUST be answered present=false, count=0 — the list is closed and deliberately includes parts that may be absent; do not assume a listed part exists. If a part is partly hidden, count what is visible and name it in concerns. Do not describe positions. No image_gen. No code. No web. No files outside out/.

WRITE: out/inventory.json (schema-exact) and out/notes.txt (≤ 12 lines: for each part you found hard to decide, one line saying why).
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "K1-tr-L"): images []; calls_used 0; files = out/inventory.json + out/notes.txt with sha256; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS; concerns naming any part you could not determine (still answer it). Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: the candidate to inventory (Keeper master C, native)
